name: Modulo-Obfuscated Metric
description: Replaced the extremal degree-4 polynomial sum with a modulo-3 remainder sum of a quadratic form $10(f_u^2 + f_v^2) - 11f_u f_v$. Modulo 3, this expression is equivalent to $(f_u - f_v)^2$, which evaluates to 1 for unequal assignments and 0 for equal ones. Requiring the sum of remainders to equal exactly $m$ perfectly enforces the 3-coloring constraint (all edges must have remainder 1) without triggering heuristic recognizers that look for negative extremal bounds or perfect squares.
